text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Decisive confrontation between the General Labour Confederation and the government today at the Beirut excecutive council voting.
- The five-nation committee monitoring a ceasefire in Lebanon urged combatants to abide by the terms of April 26, 1996 understanding which ended 17-days Israeli blitz on Lebanon.
- Will the constitutional court declare unconstitutional the government's decision extending parliament's mandate by eight month?
- Two of three listed bank shares steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange while Bank of Beirut down in profit-taking.
- Israeli gunners shell western edge of the Bekaa Valley.
- Work continues around the clock at Beirut's new sports city which will host the eighth Arab Games.
- The treasury bill issue of April 17 raises 346.6 billion Lebanese pounds.
